input.body:
## Summary

```text
Pause button layer (shared alpha / stage clock)
  ├ retained Settings / Hotkeys
  └ retained Info
supplied SWF → settings rasters / font fields
```

Replace generic settings controls with authored placements and option frames. Pause retains row identities, retraction history and one active dialog across Settings, Hotkeys and Info. Main-menu rendering/fades follow separately.

## Evidence
